tier_reason: **★ 这份是本轮最该被误收的材料，我把它挡在 P1 外，理由有三条，每条都能在文件内当场验：**（一）**编者的字与他的字之间没有任何机器可辨的记号**——Alfred Lief 的各篇导言就是紧挨着意见的散文，例如第 3 页 `Long Hours and Liberty ( Lochner v. New York , 1904)` 之后先是 Lief 写的案情与 `The question was (according to Mr. Justice Peckham) ...`，然后才接 Holmes 的异议，中间只隔一个空行——这正是 #170 指令 ★★ 说的「往往只隔一个空行」，而且**比判例汇编更糟：这里连页眉都没有**；（二）**编者自己声明删过字**，卷首照录：`The series of dots that recur in the Opinions indicate the citations of Court decisions. As these are only of technical interest, the editor has thought best to omit them for the sake of smooth reading. Where asterisks occur, they indicate omissions that occur in the original, except in the majority opinions where they denote editorial selection.` ——**它是删节转录本，不是逐字本；任何逐字引文都不能引它。**（三）**它没有提供新内容**：8-gram 实测，本份 31.5% 被 `decisions_dissents_concurrences_usreports_v187_281_en.txt` 覆盖（反向 53.0%，Jaccard 0.2466），另有 6.3%／2.7%／6.7% 被三份法院意见文件覆盖——**它那一层已经被本轮从官方汇编切出来的干净版本完整覆盖。**★ 另有 George W. Kirchwey 的 Foreword（`We come to know a man only as we see him in action ...`），整篇是别人写他的。
title: The Dissenting Opinions of Mr. Justice Holmes. Arranged with Introductory Notes, by Alfred Lief. With a Foreword by Dr. George W. Kirchwey, Former Dean, Columbia Law School. New York: The Vanguard Press, 1929
